evals.name: PostgreSQL Database Module
evals.prompt: I need to create a new Terraform module for a PostgreSQL database cluster following my module standards. Use the terraform-module-scaffold skill to generate the complete module structure including: variables.tf with T-shirt sizing (xsmall-xlarge), outputs.tf with connection info, main.tf with proper resource naming, mandatory tagging, validation blocks, and tests/module.tftest.hcl. Follow all the universal conventions and domain-specific patterns for database modules.
evals.expected_output: Complete module directory with all required files: versions.tf, variables.tf with T-shirt sizing pattern and validation, outputs.tf with sensitive connection info, main.tf with descriptive resource names (pg_primary, pg_replica), locals.tf with computed values, tests/module.tftest.hcl with validation tests, and README.md following the documentation template

evals.name: Kafka Topic Module
evals.prompt: Create a Terraform module for managing Kafka topics with the following requirements: Support creating multiple topics with different partition/replication configs, include access control for producers/consumers, add feature flags for topic compaction, follow my tagging and validation patterns. Use the terraform-module-scaffold skill to ensure all anti-patterns are avoided.
evals.expected_output: Module with: topics variable using structured object type, for_each resource creation, access control configuration, feature flags object for optional functionality, proper validation and preconditions, comprehensive tests, sanitized tag handling, and complete README

evals.name: AWX/Ansible Integration Module
evals.prompt: Build a Terraform module that integrates with AWX/Ansible Tower for infrastructure provisioning. The module should: Create job templates dynamically, handle extra_vars JSON encoding, include proper error handling, support multiple node types, follow my infrastructure module patterns. Use the terraform-module-scaffold skill.
evals.expected_output: Module with: AWX provider configuration, job template resources with JSON extra_vars, error handling patterns, node configuration objects, Python test files in scripts/tests/, validation for AWX IDs, proper resource naming (awx_job, awx_inventory), and documentation showing AWX integration examples

evals.name: Datadog Monitoring Module
evals.prompt: Create a Terraform module for Datadog monitoring that: Supports configurable monitors via map input, includes priority levels and thresholds, applies consistent tagging, handles monitor enable/disable, follows my monitoring module patterns. Ensure all anti-patterns are avoided.
evals.expected_output: Module with: monitors variable using map(object()) for type safety, for_each resource creation, threshold configuration objects, tag concatenation with common_tags, validation for monitor queries, tests validating monitor creation, and README showing monitor configuration examples
